note: Held-out set for buyer-memory preference capture. Written once, before the capture rules were run on it; never tuned against. 24 standing preferences and 30 ordinary requests.
preferences: Please keep every reply under 100 words.
I prefer bullet points over long paragraphs.
Don't use emojis in anything you write for us.
Use metric units, never imperial.
We always write numbers under ten as words.
Make sure every SQL query you give me uses explicit column names, not SELECT *.
I hate passive voice, avoid it.
From now on, address me as Dr. Okafor.
Our brand name is always written in lowercase: lumen.
Only use Postgres syntax in queries for me.
I like short subject lines, six words max.
Every code sample must include a usage example at the bottom.
Times should always be in 24-hour format.
No Oxford comma in our house style.
Whenever you give me a list, number it.
I need all prices shown in naira with the ₦ sign.
Write tests with pytest, never unittest.
Keep it formal, no slang.
Do not mention competitors by name in any copy.
Please use single quotes for strings in my JavaScript.
Headlines must be in sentence case.
Use tabs for indentation in our Go code, as gofmt does.
Avoid the word 'leverage' in anything you write.
Every email should end with a clear next step for the reader.
